messages:
sam: noticed billing tokens for /v1/generate are higher than sampled_per_min on routing-kpis
nina: I think debug_window TTL for inspect-mode is counting retries as separate samples
chez: example from tenant 'orchid': 4 quick retries -> 4 sampled rows but only 1 billed request
sam: we should dedupe before persistence, not after aggregation
pat: agreed, but need to be cautious about fingerprinting PII surface area
privacy-bot: reminder: any fingerprint must be HMACed with per-tenant salt and not include raw prompt
chez: proposal: fingerprint = HMAC(tenant_salt, request_id || route) and prehash_scrub=true
pat: prehash_scrub: drop emails, phone numbers, PCI-like tokens before any hashing
ops-bot: operational note: dedupe will reduce sample volume on low-traffic tenants; metric changes expected
nina: console needs a 3-way toggle: off / soft_dedupe / strict_dedupe so teams can choose behavior
sam: soft_dedupe: dedupe counts but keep all sample payloads for observability; strict: keep single payload per fingerprint
chez: implementable: sampling engine already has dedupe_strategy enum, just need console + API exposure
pat: must rotate HMAC salt via KMS key rotation schedule in rollout checklist
ops-bot: checklist updated: kms-rotate, canary-tenants, add deduped_samples metric, add redaction_skipped_rate metric
privacy-bot: require privacy signoff before enabling strict_dedupe for any tenant
pat: add alert: redaction_skipped_rate > 0.05% over 15m -> page privacy-oncall
nina: I'll add dashboard panels for deduped_samples and dedupe_ratio
sam: canary plan: enable soft_dedupe for tenants: demo-co, sandbox-11, partner-neo, beta-suite, integr8
chez: timeline: prototype change this sprint, privacy review early next week, canary Thu if approved
pat: PR link (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampling/pull/762 
ops-bot: note: metrics will show transient dip in sampled_per_min after rollout
sam: follow-up: let's ensure logs include dedupe_reason tag (retry_window / idempotency)
privacy-bot: also ensure fingerprint HMAC uses tenant-scoped key and key id stored but not exposed in logs
chez: action items: sam -> sampling engine PR, nina -> console toggle UX + API, pat -> privacy checklist + KMS rotation, ops -> dashboard panels
sam: acked :thumbsup:
